tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search health products sold by German online shops and pharmacies by name, PZN or EAN. Returns product keys, pack sizes, the cheapest price and shop count. Each result carries a disclosure (affiliate links, price source) and, for medicines, a compliance_notice with the statutory German notice. Price

tools.name: search_product_offers
tools.description: List current offers (price, shipping, delivery, stock, shop link) for one product from search_products, optionally for one pack (a pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page; it can hold several PZNs, e.g. an original and its reimports), plus the lowest price of the last 90 days. unit_

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_product_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List current offers (price, shipping, delivery, stock, shop link) for one product from search_products, optionally for one pack size, plus the lowest price of the last 90 days. unit_price is the normalized base price (Grundpreis) of the offer: {value, per} in EUR per 1 l, per 1 kg or per piece (per " → after: "List current offers (price, shipping, delivery, stock, shop link) for one product from search_products, optionally for one pack (a pack is one pack-size label as shown on the product page; it can hold several PZNs, e.g. an original and its reimports), plus the lowest price of the last 90 days. unit_"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
